description_en: Retrieves the details of a model operator API key
description_zh: 获取模型算子 API KEY 详情
name: DescribeModelOperatorApiKey

ApiKey.description_en: The plaintext API key. This field is returned only when Status is Running
ApiKey.description_zh: API Key 明文。仅当 Status 为 Running 时返回；其他状态不返回此字段

Endpoint.description_en: The endpoint of the model operator service. This field is returned only when Status is Running
Endpoint.description_zh: 模型算子服务的调用地址。仅当 Status 为 Running 时返回；其他状态不返回此字段

Status.description_en:
The status of the API key. Valid values:

Creating: The API key is being created.
Running: The API key is running.
Locked: The API key is locked and cannot be used to call the model operator service.
Deleting: The API key is being deleted. You can still query it by calling this operation, but it is no longer displayed in the results of ListModelOperatorApiKeys.

The plaintext API key and endpoint are returned only when Status is Running. After the deletion is complete, this operation returns a resource not found error. The status indicates the processing result of the control plane. A short propagation delay may occur before the status takes effect on the data plane
Status.description_zh:
API Key 的状态。取值：

Creating：创建中。
Running：运行中。
Locked：已锁定，不能用于调用模型算子服务。
Deleting：删除中，仍可通过本接口查询，但不再显示在 ListModelOperatorApiKeys 的结果中。

仅当 Status 为 Running 时，返回 ApiKey 明文和 Endpoint。删除完成后，本接口返回资源不存在错误。状态表示控制面处理结果，数据面生效可能存在短暂传播延迟
